Key theological pressure points include treatment of desert dead, respect for water-spirit customs at oases, and absence of undead or binding magics near sacred ground.

Order of the Storm's Edge (Emperor's Talons)

The Codex of the Emperor's Talons — complete treatise on the hybrid fighting style of sword and claw, including foundational philosophy, claw configurations, the two ur-styles (rapier-and-dagger vs maul-and-pincers), core techniques, weapon selection doctrine, Evening's Edge integration, and five legendary duels of the historical lineage. Integrated with Evening's Edge (Shi'van Baen'und's weapon and equipment product line).

Preservation and teaching of the Emperor's Talons hybrid style. Doctrinal integration with Evening's Edge means practitioners gain access to Institut-grade primary weapons and articulated claw configurations. Active instruction pipeline producing fighters who can treat the system as a four-weapon interaction model rather than dual-wielding, which creates tactical superiority against conventional dual-wielders who read the engagement wrong.

The Order preserves and transmits the Emperor's Talons — a combat doctrine built on the Four-Weapon Principle (primary weapon as 'statement', claws as 'grammar' that complete rather than compete with the primary). The revised edition of the codex incorporates Baen Innovations and the Evening's Edge doctrine, creating a formal alignment between the Order and Shi'van's production lines. The style is not a dual-wielding system — it is a system of two weapons performing different functions in continuous interaction. Full codex content (~960 lines covering 21 sections from foundational philosophy through final wisdom and appendices) may warrant a separate System Reference entry as combat doctrine; this Faction page tracks the living practitioner order itself.
